title: SymbolInstance natural size: add width/height for align, bounds, transform panel
description:
SymbolInstance (packages/core/src/engine/types.ts) has no width/height fields. This breaks several dependent features:

1. AlignPanel (AlignPanel.tsx line 57-62) returns { width:0, height:0 } for instances and groups — align left/right/center and distribute operations silently produce wrong results when any selected object is a symbol instance.
2. getTransformedBounds / getSelectionBounds in bounds.ts return 0×0 for instances.
3. The TransformPanel cannot display or edit W/H for symbol instances.
4. Snap-to-object bounds (snap.ts) uses objectBounds which derive from these utilities, so snapping to the edge of a symbol instance is broken.

## What to implement

### Model change
Add optional cached natural size to SymbolInstance:
  naturalWidth?: number;
  naturalHeight?: number;
These are computed once from the symbol's first-frame shape union bounds and stored when the instance is placed (stage_place_instance MCP tool, Shell.tsx handlePlaceInstance, library drag-to-stage). They do NOT need to be recomputed dynamically — they represent the unscaled symbol bounding box.

### Computation helper
Add computeSymbolNaturalSize(symbol: Symbol, doc: FlashDocument): { width: number; height: number } in packages/core/src/engine/bounds.ts (or a new symbol-bounds.ts). Walk the first keyframe's displayObjects of the symbol's timeline and union their bounds.

### Thread through
- Populate naturalWidth/naturalHeight in:
  - Shell.tsx: handlePlaceInstance, library drop onto stage, library_convert_to_symbol
  - MCP tool: stage_place_instance
- Update AlignPanel.tsx getObjectBounds() case "instance" to use naturalWidth/naturalHeight * scaleX/scaleY if available.
- Update getTransformedBounds (bounds.ts) to use naturalWidth/naturalHeight.

### Tests
- Unit test: symbol with two shapes → computeSymbolNaturalSize returns correct union bounds.
- Unit test: getSelectionBounds on a SymbolInstance with naturalWidth/naturalHeight returns correct rect.

## Acceptance
- Placing a symbol instance on stage sets naturalWidth/naturalHeight.
- AlignPanel align-left on two symbol instances moves them to the correct X positions.
- TransformPanel shows the correct pixel dimensions for a selected symbol instance.
